name: git-commit
tagline_zh: 还在为提交信息纠结？它自动按 Conventional Commits 生成，还从 CLAUDE.md 读项目规矩。
tagline_en: Stop agonizing over commit messages. It auto-generates Conventional Commits, reads project rules from CLAUDE.md.
desc_en: Creates git commits following Conventional Commits format with type/scope/subject. Use when user wants to commit changes, create commit, save work, or stage and commit. Enforces project-specific conventions from CLAUDE.md.
why_zh: 同类工具只会套模板，它却会读 CLAUDE.md 里的项目专属约定，让每次提交都符合团队规范，细节到位。
why_en: Unlike template-only tools, it reads CLAUDE.md for project-specific conventions, ensuring every commit aligns with your team's.
